target: quarterly P52 airborne hours / aircraft days assigned, summed across detailed financial regions and passenger/combined aircraft configurations within a certificate carrier and NB/WB group
features: intercept, utilization lag 1 and lag 4, five series offsets, group-specific Q2/Q3/Q4 seasonal offsets; feature standardization fitted on training rows only
selection_metric: equal-weight mean of series-by-horizon MAE across the common eligible origin/target set; ties use the first declared ridge penalty
forecast_rule: frozen training coefficients; recursive multi-quarter predictions without intermediate future observations; bounded [0,24] airborne hours/day
uncertainty: No calibrated forecast intervals or causal claims in this first estimation artifact. Residual/parameter uncertainty and whole-engine evaluation remain required.
vintage: October 2026 current-download reconstruction; no historical as-of claim
